skill.name: skill-builder
skill.description: Interactive skill creation assistant that guides users through building Agent Skills for Claude Code. Use it to design skill structure, write clear descriptions, create templates, and organize supporting files.
skill.summary: Guide users through creating structured Agent Skills for Claude Code.

security_audit.summary: All static findings were false positives from Markdown examples, templates, and documentation references. The skill contains no executable helper files, and no prompt-injection attempts were found in SKILL.md or REFERENCE.md. Generated scripts and install paths should still be reviewed before use because the skill can guide users to create files and commands.

content.value_statement: Building a useful Agent Skill requires clear triggers, structure, and safe supporting files. This skill guides Claude or Codex through discovery, design, creation, and handoff.
actual_capabilities: Guides discovery questions for a new skill purpose, triggers, and scope.
Helps write SKILL.md descriptions, frontmatter, instructions, and examples.
Recommends simple, script-powered, or reference-backed skill layouts.
Provides Python script templates using uv and PEP 723 metadata.
Explains testing, activation checks, and iteration steps.
limitations: It does not automatically validate generated skills against marketplace policy.
Users must review generated scripts before running them.
Claude Code behavior can change, so current documentation may need verification.
It provides guidance and templates, not a packaged skill compiler.

use_cases.title: Create a personal workflow skill
use_cases.description: Design a focused skill for repeated tasks such as document review, test analysis, or report generation.

use_cases.title: Standardize project skills
use_cases.description: Create team-shared skills with clear triggers, file locations, examples, and maintenance notes.

use_cases.title: Plan script-backed automation
use_cases.description: Decide when a skill needs helper scripts and document safe usage for those scripts.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Use skill-builder to help me create a simple Agent Skill for [task]. Ask clarifying questions before writing the skill.

prompt_templates.title: Design a project skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a project-level Claude Code skill for [workflow]. Include triggers, scope, file structure, and test prompts.

prompt_templates.title: Add script support
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a script-backed skill for [automation]. Decide which scripts are needed and describe their inputs, outputs, and review steps.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an advanced skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my proposed skill for [domain]. Improve its trigger description, structure, safety notes, examples, and activation tests.

output_examples.input: I need a skill for summarizing customer calls.
output: A refined skill purpose and trigger description.
A recommended instruction-only structure for the first version.
Example prompts to test whether the skill activates correctly.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for analyzing Python test coverage.
output: A focused description with pytest and coverage trigger terms.
A recommended structure with optional helper script support.
A handoff checklist for dependencies, examples, and testing.

output_examples.input: Improve this rough skill idea before I publish it.
output: Clearer activation language and narrower scope.
Suggested file organization using progressive disclosure.
Review notes for scripts, dependencies, and user-facing examples.

best_practices: Start with concrete trigger phrases that users would naturally write.
Keep each skill focused on one capability and move details into reference files.
Review generated scripts, dependencies, and file locations before use.
anti_patterns: Creating broad skills that try to handle unrelated workflows.
Adding helper scripts when clear instructions would solve the task.
Running generated commands or scripts before reviewing their purpose.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create Agent Skills with clear descriptions, instructions, examples, and optional supporting files.

faq.question: Can it create script-backed skills?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan Python or Bash helper scripts and document how users should run them.

faq.question: Does it publish skills automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides creation and handoff, but publishing and installation remain user-controlled steps.

faq.question: Does it work with Codex?
faq.answer: The guidance is useful for Codex workflows, but the source skill is written for Claude Code Agent Skills.

faq.question: Should generated scripts be reviewed?
faq.answer: Yes. Review scripts, dependencies, paths, and inputs before running or sharing them.

faq.question: When should I use a reference file?
faq.answer: Use a reference file when the skill needs detailed examples, APIs, troubleshooting, or long workflow notes.
